  .i to pe'a zoi gy. trial / test .gy toi.
## zoi gy. final .gy

.i zoi gy. final .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u fanmo
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. last / final .gy toi.


## zoi gy. leap .gy .e zoi gy. fall .gy

.i zoi gy. leap .gy cu se smuni lo nu plipe (pe'a)
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. jump/leap (metaphor) .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. fall .gy cu se smuni lo nu farlu (pe'a)
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. fall (metaphor) .gy toi.


## zoi gy. patience .gy

.i zoi gy. patience .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u depcni
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. patient endurance / waiting without frustration .gy toi.

## zoi gy. kindness .gy

.i zoi gy. kindness .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u xendo
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. gentle benevolence .gy toi.

## zoi gy. jealousy .gy

.i zoi gy. jealousy .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u jilra
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. envy / jealousy toward another .gy toi.

## zoi gy. arrogant .gy

.i zoi gy. arrogant .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u na'e cumla fi lo ka ce'u zmadu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. not humble about superiority / arrogant .gy toi.

## zoi gy. rude .gy

.i zoi gy. rude .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u na'e clite
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. discourteous / rude .gy toi.

## zoi gy. self-benefit .gy

.i zoi gy. self-benefit .gy cu se smuni lo xamgu be lo sevzi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. one's own advantage / what is good for oneself .gy toi.
## zoi gy. for its own sake .gy

.i zoi gy. for its own sake .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se srana lo sevzi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. for oneself / self-serving .gy toi.


## zoi gy. provoked .gy

.i zoi gy. provoked .gy cu se smuni lo nu co'a fengu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. become angry / be provoked .gy toi.

## zoi gy. endure .gy

.i zoi gy. endure .gy cu se smuni lo nu renvi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. keep going / persist through .gy toi.


## zoi gy. account .gy

.i zoi gy. account .gy cu se smuni lo vreji be lo datni
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. ledger / record preserved .gy toi.


## zoi gy. telos .gy .e zoi gy. free will .gy

.i zoi gy. telos .gy cu se smuni lo fanmo mukti
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. ultimate end/goal .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. free will .gy cu se smuni lo zifre cuxna
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. voluntary/libertarian choice .gy toi.
## zoi gy. epicenter .gy

.i zoi gy. epicenter .gy cu se smuni lo mutce midju be su'o dacti
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. central point .gy toi.


## zoi gy. sacrament .gy .e zoi gy. covenant .gy

.i zoi gy. sacrament .gy cu se smuni lo censa ritli
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. sacred rite/ordinance .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. covenant .gy cu se smuni lo si'o simxu nupre
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. mutual commitment / covenant-concept .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. sacramental covenant .gy cu se smuni lo si'o jicmu censa simxu nupre
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. foundational sacred mutual commitment / sacramental covenant .gy toi.

## zoi gy. root .gy

.i zoi gy. root .gy cu se smuni lo krasi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. fundamental origin .gy toi.


## zoi gy. modality .gy .e zoi gy. contingency .gy .e zoi gy. fideism .gy .e zoi gy. maxim .gy

.i zoi gy. modality .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se srana lo ka cumki .e lo ka sarcu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. modal status / possibility-or-necessity dimension .gy toi.

.i zoi gy. fundamental modal disposition .gy cu se smuni lo si'o jicmu ckaji pe lo marde flalu poi se srana lo ka cumki .e lo ka sarcu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. foundational possibility/necessity-related characteristic of the Moral Law .gy toi.

.i zoi gy. contingency .gy cu se smuni lo ka su'o se fasnu cu cumki gi'e na sarcu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. could-be-otherwise / not-necessary .gy toi.

.i zoi gy. fideism .gy cu se smuni lo si'o krici lo du'u lo si'o drani cu jetnu
  poi na nitcu lo nu ke'a se krinu .a lo nu lo krinu be ke'a cu se facki
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. faith / belief not dependent on prior discovered justification .gy toi.

.i zoi gy. maxim .gy cu se smuni lo javni be lo nu zukte
  poi lo prenu cu cuxna ke'a
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. guiding principle for action .gy toi.
## zoi gy. contingent .gy

.i zoi gy. contingent .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u cumki gi'e na sarcu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. possible / not necessary / could be otherwise .gy toi.


## zoi gy. justification .gy

.i zoi gy. justification .gy cu se smuni lo si'o krinu poi banzu tezu'e lo nu lo bridi .a lo nu zukte cu drani
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. being justified / justificatory status / warrantedness .gy toi.


## zoi gy. moral luck .gy

.i zoi gy. moral luck .gy cu se smuni lo si'o funca poi se srana lo marde
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. luck/fortune as it bears on moral standing or outcome .gy toi.

## zoi gy. hedonic treadmill .gy

.i zoi gy. hedonic treadmill .gy cu se smuni lo nu lo prenu cu rapli djica lo nu se snada
  gi'e ba'o se snada cu rapli djica lo drata
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. repeated desire-satisfaction loop / wanting more after getting what one wanted .gy toi.

## zoi gy. robust .gy .e zoi gy. radical .gy

.i zoi gy. robust .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u stali gi'e na frili lo nu se daspo
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. robust / resilient / hard to break down .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. radical .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se srana lo krasi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. root-level / radical / concerning the roots .gy toi.
## zoi gy. explanation .gy

.i zoi gy. explanation .gy cu se smuni lo se ciksi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. explanation / elucidation / why-account .gy toi.


## zoi gy. sufficient .gy .e zoi gy. necessary .gy

.i zoi gy. sufficient .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u banzu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. sufficient / enough for a purpose .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. necessary .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u sarcu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. necessary / required / prerequisite .gy toi.

## zoi gy. depend .gy

.i zoi gy. depend .gy cu se smuni lo nu se krinu fi da
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. hang on / be based on / rest on .gy toi.


## zoi gy. risk .gy

.i zoi gy. risk .gy cu se smuni lo nu ckape
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. taking a chance under danger .gy toi.

## zoi gy. neurochemical .gy

.i zoi gy. neurochemical .gy cu se smuni lo se srana be lo nivji be lo menli .e lo xadni
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. brain/body chemistry .gy toi.


## zoi gy. end .gy .e zoi gy. means .gy

.i zoi gy. end .gy cu se smuni lo fanmo be lo nu zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. purpose as final end .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. means .gy cu se smuni lo tutci be lo nu snada lo fanmo
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. instrument / means-to-an-end .gy toi.



## zoi gy. disposition .gy

.i zoi gy. disposition .gy cu se smuni lo si'o tcaci poi se srana lo ka bredi lo nu zukte ta'i su'o tadji
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. dispositional tendency / standing readiness .gy toi.

## zoi gy. modal disposition .gy

.i zoi gy. modal disposition .gy cu se smuni lo si'o tcaci poi se srana lo ka cumki .e lo ka sarcu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. modal disposition / disposition concerning possibility and necessity .gy toi.


## zoi gy. intention .gy .e zoi gy. effort .gy

.i zoi gy. intention .gy cu se smuni lo si'o mukti poi lo prenu cu cuxna ke'a tezu'e lo nu zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. concept of chosen purpose/aim .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. effort .gy cu se smuni lo si'o troci poi se srana lo nu zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. effort-concept / trying / exertion toward action .gy toi.
## zoi gy. doxastic .gy .e zoi gy. voluntarism .gy

.i zoi gy. doxastic .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se srana lo krici
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. belief-related / pertaining to belief .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. voluntarism .gy cu se smuni lo ka lo prenu cu ka'e cuxna lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u krici .a lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. belief/action subject to will or choice .gy toi.


## zoi gy. sacrificial .gy

.i zoi gy. sacrificial .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u dunda lo se banzu be lo sevzi lo drata
  gi'e na jundi lo nu ri xamgu lo sevzi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. self-giving / not attending to one's own benefit .gy toi.
## zoi gy. intentionality .gy

.i zoi gy. intentionality .gy cu se smuni lo menli tcini poi platu lo nu zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. directedness of will/aim .gy toi.


## zoi gy. override .gy

.i zoi gy. override .gy cu se smuni lo nu da bapli lo nu ro lo drata mukti cu na se pilno tezu'e lo nu zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. overriding / compelling competing reasons not to guide action .gy toi.


## zoi gy. ready-to-hand .gy

.i zoi gy. ready-to-hand .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u bredi lo nu se pilno
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. available-for-use / ready-to-use / functioning in use .gy toi.

## zoi gy. present-at-hand .gy

.i zoi gy. present-at-hand .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se zgana pe'a gi'e bredi lo nu se lanli
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. available for observation/analysis as an object .gy toi.

## zoi gy. phenomenological .gy

.i zoi gy. phenomenological .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se srana lo nu ce'u se zgana .e lo nu ce'u simlu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. about lived experience / the way things appear in experience .gy toi.

.i ja'e bo lo si'o prami cu curmi lo nu mi'a mleca fi lo ka ce'u sepli lo drata prenu.
-- la'o gy. Anon .gy., la'o gy. The Interwebs .gy.

ni'o ma du lo si'o prami?<<ref "b">>
.i lo si'o prami cu du lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu (to pe'a zoi gy. goodwill .gy toi).

.i ri du lo si'o mukti fe lo nu mi'a zukte fi mi'a poi se srana lo marde
  (to pe'a zoi gy. moral motivation .gy toi).
.i ku'i ri rinka po'o lo nu mi'a zukte ja'i le'i javni
  poi mi'a cuxna ke'a tezu'e lo nu mi'a zukte
  gi'e sruma bu'u le munje poi cumki lo du'u lo drata prenu cu fanmo po'o be le nu mi'a zukte
    gi'e na du lo tutci po'o be lo nu mi'a snada.

.i lo si'o prami cu du lo si'o nupre fe lo nu mi'a tinbe lo si'o drani
  (to pe'a zoi gy. commitment .gy toi).
.i ja'e bo mi'a bilga lo nu mi'a tinbe lo si'o drani ri
  (to pe'a zoi gy. responsibility / obligation .gy toi).

.i lo si'o prami cu du lo si'o krici lo du'u lo si'o drani cu jetnu
  gi'e na nitcu lo nu ke'a se krinu .a lo nu lo krinu be ke'a cu se facki
  (to pe'a zoi gy. fideism qua The Right .gy toi)
  to la'oi irwartfrr: ta'i lo drani tadji .e ca lo nu lo drani tcika .e mu'i lo nu lo drani mukti toi.

.i lo si'o prami cu krasi (to pe'a zoi gy. root .gy toi) be lo si'o censa simxu nupre
  (to pe'a zoi gy. sacramental covenant .gy toi).
.i ri du lo pamoi si'o tcaci pe lo marde flalu
  poi se srana lo ka cumki .e lo ka sarcu
  (to pe'a zoi gy. fundamental modal disposition .gy toi).

.i ja'e bo lo du'u lo si'o prami cu zasti cu nibli lo du'u su'o se fasnu cu cumki gi'e na sarcu
  (to pe'a zoi gy. contingency .gy toi).

.i fi lo smuni: do na kakne lo nu co'a prami ta'i lo nu pe'a farlu fe ri
  ki'u lo nu do pe'a plipe fe ri cu sarcu.<<ref "inl">>

ni'o ro da poi ke'a prenu zo'u su'o de poi ke'a pe'a minra be lo si'o xamgu poi se simlu zo'u da se trina de
  (to pe'a zoi gy. semblatic .gy toi).
.i ji'a ganai da se trina de po'o fi lo ka ce'u xamgu da .a fi lo ka ce'u se srana da
  (to pe'a zoi gy. for its own sake .gy toi)
  gi lo nu da se trina de po'o fi lo ka ce'u xamgu da .a fi lo ka ce'u se srana da cu na mapti fa la'oi irwartfrr.

.i lo si'o prami na du lo si'o nelci (to pe'a zoi gy. like .gy toi).
.i ki'u bo lo prenu na ka'e jitro lo si'o nelci
  .i ku'i lo prenu cu ka'e jitro lo si'o prami.<<ref "tr">>

.i lo si'o trina (to pe'a zoi gy. attraction .gy toi) cu na banzu (to pe'a zoi gy. sufficient .gy toi) tezu'e lo si'o prami.
.i lo si'o prami cu se srana lo nu lo prenu cu ka'e cuxna lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u krici .a lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u zukte
  (to pe'a zoi gy. doxastic .gy .e zoi gy. voluntarism .gy toi).
.i ri se srana lo si'o mukti poi lo prenu cu cuxna ke'a tezu'e lo nu zukte
  .e lo si'o troci poi se srana lo nu zukte
  (to pe'a zoi gy. intention .gy .e zoi gy. effort .gy toi).

.i do na ka'e sutra co'a nelci lo da poi do na nelci ke'a ta'i lo nu lo degji be lo do xance cu bikla.
.i ku'i do ka'e cuxna lo nu do prami da.

.i lo si'o prami cu zvati lo mutce midju be lo fanmo be lo si'o zifre cuxna
  ki'u lo nu ri du lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu.

.i lo si'o prami na po'o du lo si'o pajni (to pe'a zoi gy. appraisal .gy toi).
.i ri du lo nu lo prenu cu sevzi jitro (to pe'a zoi gy. autonomous .gy toi)
  gi'e facki fi lo ni lo drata prenu cu vamji kei
    poi na se srana lo te jvinu
    (to pe'a zoi gy. dignity .gy toi).
.i lo ni lo drata prenu cu vamji kei cu sarcu lo nu da sinma lo drata prenu poi se vamji
  ta'i lo ka ce'u se srana lo te jvinu
  (to pe'a zoi gy. respect .gy toi).

.i lo si'o prami poi na se krinu (to pe'a zoi gy. justification .gy toi) cu po'o du lo si'o trina poi simlu lo si'o prami ta'i lo nu lo krinu be lo si'o prami cu na se djuno.

ni'o simlu lo du'u su'o pagbu be lo si'o prami poi se sanji cu na se sanji (to pe'a zoi gy. conscious / unconscious components .gy toi).

.i fi'o se srana lo nu lo si'o prami cu na'e se srana lo pensi (to pe'a zoi gy. non-cognitive .gy toi) kei
  ri du lo gunma be loi tcaci poi se srana lo cinmo
    (to pe'a zoi gy. affective algorithms .gy toi)
    gi'e se cilre fi lo nu rapli zukte
    (to pe'a zoi gy. habituation .gy toi)
    tezu'e lo marde vrude
    (to pe'a zoi gy. virtue .gy toi).
.i lei tcaci cu rinka lo nu ca lo nu mi'a zukte cu frili gi'e bredi fa lo nu mi'a cinmo zo'e fi lo si'o se bilga poi na se srana lo se djica
  fi'o se srana lo nu se zgana .e lo nu simlu
  (to pe'a zoi gy. ready-to-hand phenomenological attitudinal being .gy toi)
  (to pe'a zoi gy. categorical imperative .gy toi).

.i fi'o se srana lo nu lo si'o prami cu se srana lo pensi (to pe'a zoi gy. cognitive .gy toi) kei
  ri nitcu lo nu lo prenu cu ca lo nu zgana lo tcila
    (to pe'a zoi gy. present-at-hand .gy toi)
    lanli lo tcila gi'e kanji lo si'o drani fi lo tcila.

.i lo si'o prami cu pe'a zbasu lo mapti stura ta'i lo jemna tadji
  gi'e porpi lo stura be lo to'e drani se jinvi
  gi'e facki fi lo fatci poi pu se mipri
  (to pe'a zoi gy. diamondically constructive and redpill-ed deconstructive .gy toi)
  to la'oi irwartfrr: ta'i lo drani tadji .e ca lo nu lo drani tcika .e mu'i lo nu lo drani mukti toi.

.i fi'o se srana lo nu lo si'o prami cu se srana lo nu su'o ckaji be ri cu se nibli lo ckaji be lo dacti poi mi'a ka'e viska kei
  (to pe'a zoi gy. metaphysical supervenience upon perceptible objects .gy toi)
  .i ja'e bo cumki fa lo nu su'o ckaji be ri cu na ka'e se cusku fi lo valsi
  (to pe'a zoi gy. ineffable .gy toi).<<ref "i">>

ni'o sei badri lo du'u lo si'o prami cu se dunli fi lo pa marde vrude poi se jalge lo nu ro lo marde vrude cu se jmina
  .i ku'i ri sarcu (to pe'a zoi gy. necessary .gy toi) gi'e na banzu (to pe'a zoi gy. sufficient .gy toi)
    tezu'e lo ka zoi gy. eudaimonia .gy.

.i lo nu lo prenu cu mulno fi lo ka ce'u zasti xamgu
  bu'u le ka zoi gy. eudaimonia .gy poi se krinu<<ref "eu">>
  cu se jalge lo funca poi se srana lo marde
  (to pe'a zoi gy. moral luck .gy toi).

.i ku'i lo si'o prami cu banzu tezu'e lo nu se krinu
  (to pe'a zoi gy. justification .gy toi)
  ki'u lo nu ri du lo si'o krinu.

.i ja'e bo lo nu mi'a jorne (to pe'a zoi gy. bind .gy toi) lo si'o prami
  .e lo nu lo si'o prami cu zbasu (to pe'a zoi gy. constitute .gy toi) lo mi'a se zasti
  cu banzu tezu'e lo nu mi'a snada lo fanmo be lo marde zukte poi se srana lo tcini be mi'a
  (to pe'a zoi gy. contextually particularized telos of moral agency .gy toi)
  .i ku'i ri na kakne lo nu sisti lo nu lo remna cu rapli djica lo nu se snada
    tezu'e lo nu se cpacu lo se pluka be lo se djica
    gi'e ba'o se snada cu rapli djica lo drata
    (to pe'a zoi gy. hedonic treadmill .gy toi).

.i lo si'o prami na po'o du lo nu ckape (to pe'a zoi gy. risk .gy toi)
  tezu'e lo nu se cpacu lo se pluka be lo xadni
    (to pe'a zoi gy. neurochemical reward for cooperative behavior .gy toi)
    poi jalge lo nu simxu gunka:<<ref "g">>
  .i ri du lo menli tcini poi platu lo nu zukte
    (to pe'a zoi gy. intentionality .gy toi)
    gi'e rinka lo nu le'i drata mukti cu se vimcu fi lo nu zukte
      ta'i lo nu dunda lo se banzu be lo sevzi lo drata
      (to pe'a zoi gy. sacrificially overrides all other reasons .gy toi).
  .i ji'a lo nu mi'a gleki cu cmima le'i drata mukti poi se vimcu fi lo nu zukte.

.i lo si'o prami cu mutce stali (to pe'a zoi gy. robust .gy toi)
  gi'e mutce se srana lo krasi (to pe'a zoi gy. radical .gy toi)
  .i ja'e bo lo nu mi'a ciksi ri cu mutce nandu
    gi'e ku'i ri na cirko lo krinu.

ni'o ne'i ro lo prenu (to pe'a zoi gy. individual .gy toi) zo'u
.i lo si'o prami cu du pe'a zoi gy. agape .gy.
.i ri du lo mapti nu
    lo si'o cinse prami (pe'a zoi gy. eros .gy) .e lo si'o pendo prami (pe'a zoi gy. philia .gy)
    cu se jmina
    gi'e binxo lo pa
    gi'e na'e dukti
    (to pe'a zoi gy. fitting sublational fusion of eros and philia .gy toi).

.i lo si'o prami cu du
    lo nu mi'a facki fi lo ni lo se prami cu vamji kei
      gi'e tugni lo du'u lo ka ce'u vamji lo se prami kei cu jinzi lo se prami
      (to pe'a zoi gy. assentive discovery of intrinsic value .gy toi)
  .e lo nu mi'a zbasu lo zifre cuxna be mi'a tezu'e lo se prami
      (to pe'a zoi gy. self-creation of our will toward it .gy toi).

.i lo si'o prami cu du
    lo rinka poi se krinu lo nu ke'a drani fo lo marde
  .e lo jalge poi se jbena lo nu loi dukti cu se jmina gi'e binxo lo pa gi'e na'e dukti
    (to pe'a zoi gy. morally justified cause and emergent consequence of the sublation of contraries .gy toi).

ni'o ne'i lo gunma poi kakne lo nu zukte (to pe'a zoi gy. collective agent .gy toi) zo'u
.i lo si'o prami cu du lo nu loi pagbu be le gunma cu jorne loi drata pagbu be le gunma
  sepi'o lo ka ce'u vlipa lo nu venfu ta'i lo nu fraxu kei be le gunma
    (to pe'a zoi gy. forgivingly retaliating power .gy toi)
  .e sepi'o lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju kei be lo te jvinu pe le gunma
    (to pe'a zoi gy. perspective decentralization .gy toi).

ni'o lo nu rapli cu nibli lo nu rapli gi'e na sisti (pe'a) cu se cmene pe'a zoi gy. infinigressive recursion .gy toi.
.i lo si'o prami fi'o se srana lo munje (to pe'a zoi gy. cosmic .gy toi) fi'o se srana lo cimni rapli krefu cu simlu lo ka ce'u du pa se ckaji be lo du'u su'o bridi cu jetnu je jitfa
  (to pe'a zoi gy. dialetheia .gy toi)
  noi ta'i lo tadji be lo nu fapro (to pe'a zoi gy. dialectic .gy toi)
    tezu'e lo nu rapli jivbu lo vajni dukti
    gi'e galfi lo vajni dukti lo ka ce'u sarxe gi'e na fapro
    (to pe'a zoi gy. weaving and returning salient opposition into harmonic flatness .gy toi).

ni'o lo si'o prami cu du lo nu mi'a zbasu lo tcini poi se srana lo te jvinu pe mi'a
  tezu'e lo nu le tcini poi se srana lo te jvinu pe mi'a cu ckini
    le tcini poi na se srana lo te jvinu gi'e vasru ro lo tcini
    fi lo ckini poi drani fo lo marde.

.i lo si'o prami cu se srana lo marde
  gi'e na ka'e se ciksi fi lo krinu be lo nu lo si'o prami cu se srana lo marde
  (to pe'a zoi gy. morally mystical .gy toi).

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 14) — v1356

## zoi gy. algorithm .gy

.i zoi gy. algorithm .gy cu se smuni lo si'o tadji poi se pilno tezu'e lo nu gasnu
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. procedure-concept / rule-governed method / algorithm .gy toi.
## zoi gy. unconscious .gy

.i zoi gy. unconscious .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u na se sanji
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. not consciously accessible .gy toi.

## zoi gy. conscious .gy

.i zoi gy. conscious .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se sanji
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. consciously accessible .gy toi.

## zoi gy. cognitive .gy .e zoi gy. non-cognitive .gy

.i zoi gy. cognitive .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u se srana lo pensi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. thought-based .gy toi.
.i zoi gy. non-cognitive .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u na'e se srana lo pensi
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. not thought-based .gy toi.


## zoi gy. virtue .gy

.i zoi gy. virtue .gy cu se smuni lo ka ce'u vrude
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. virtue / virtuousness / moral excellence .gy toi.

## zoi gy. habituation .gy

.i zoi gy. habituation .gy cu se smuni lo nu se cilre fi lo nu rapli zukte
  .i to pe'a zoi gy. formed by repeated practice .gy toi.


## (la'oi Aquinas: zo cuxna (na zo djica) tezu'e lo se smuni be zoi gy. will the good .gy)

.i mi galfi le Aquinas se cusku:
  - "djica" → "cuxna"
  - "cuxna lo nu lo drata cu se xamgu" → "cuxna lo se xamgu be lo drata prenu"
  .i tezu'e lo nu smuni zoi gy. will .gy cu se cpacu lo nu cuxna (lo nu cuxna lo se zukte) .i na po'o lo nu djica (lo nu djica).
---

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 15) — v1357
## (la'oi cummings: fanva lo se smuni be zoi gy. axis of the universe .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska:
  - "lo romli'i be lo munje" → "lo romli'i pe lo munje"
  .i tezu'e lo nu zo pe cu frili lo nu se jimpe lo du'u lo romli'i cu se srana lo munje.
---

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 16) — v1358
## (la'oi Dostoevsky: lo se renvi be lo ro munje; .e zoi gy. not only ... but also .. .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska:
  - "cikre lo se renvi be lo munje" → "cikre lo se renvi be lo ro munje"
  - mi na pilno .e po'o; mi cusku re bridi gi'e pilno zo ji'a tezu'e lo se smuni be zoi gy. also .gy lo se jmina bridi.
---

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 17) — v1359
## (la'oi MacDonald: fanva zoi gy. hate all hate .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska:
  - "ko xebni ro lo nu xebni" → "ko xebni ro lo si'o xebni"
  .i tezu'e lo nu mi djica lo nu zoi gy. hate all hate .gy cu se jimpe lo nu xebni lo si'o xebni (xebni lo ka xebni),
    na lo nu xebni ro lo fasnu.
---

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 18) — v1360
## (la'oi Lacan: fanva zoi gy. I mutilate you .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska:
  - "katna su'o pagbu be do" → "katna su'o pagbu be lo do xadni"
  .i tezu'e lo nu zoi gy. mutilate you .gy cu se jimpe lo nu katna su'o pagbu be lo do xadni.
---

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 19) — v1361
## (la'oi Kempis: lo se cusku be zoi gy. it believes that it may and can do all things .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska:
  - "krici lo du'u ro da zo'u cumki lo nu ri gasnu da" → "krici lo du'u ro da zo'u cumki .e kakne lo nu ri gasnu da"
  .i tezu'e lo nu zoi gy. may and can .gy cu se cpacu lo nu cumki (zoi gy. may .gy) .e kakne (zoi gy. can .gy).

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 20) — v1362
## (la'oi Anon: zoi gy. reducer of Ego .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska:
  - "jdika lo ni lo sevzi cu zmadu ro lo drata" → "jdika lo ni lo sevzi cu se barda"
  .i tezu'e lo nu la'oi Ego cu se jimpe lo ni lo sevzi cu se barda (lo ni lo sevzi cu zmadu lo drata).
---

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 21) — v1363
## (lo jinzi se vamji poi na se jvinu: zoi gy. merits all subjective respect .gy → zoi gy. everyone must respect it .gy)

.i mi galfi le bridi be lo “jinzi se vamji”:
  - "sarcu lo nu ro lo se jinvi cu sinma ke'a" → "sarcu lo nu ro lo prenu cu sinma ke'a"
  .i tezu'e lo nu zoi gy. merits all subjective respect .gy cu se jimpe lo nu ro lo prenu bilga lo nu sinma.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 22) — v1364
## (le nalsanji/sanji prami se ciska pagbu: jmina lo se smuni be zoi gy. habituated affective algorithms .gy .e zoi gy. ready-to-hand .gy / zoi gy. present-at-hand .gy)

### se jmina notci fi le nalsanji / pensi se ciska pagbu

.i le cilre tadji be lo cinmo poi se cmima lo si'o prami cu se bredi lo nu se pilno ca'o lo nu zukte
.i ri se cmima lo selcmi be lo cinmo skamytcaci poi se cilre fi lo nu rapli zukte
  tezu'e lo marde vrude.

.i le kanji be lo si'o drani cu se srana lo pensi ca lo nu se zgana
.i lo du'u su'o bridi cu jetnu je jitfa (pe'a) cu se cmene pe'a lo du'u su'o bridi cu jetnu je jitfa (to pe'a zoi gy. dialetheia .gy toi).
.i lo nu fapro .e lo nu rapli jivbu lo fapro (pe'a) cu se cmene pe'a lo fapro tadji (to pe'a zoi gy. dialectic .gy toi).

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 23) — v1371
## (le grec cmene be lo smuni notci: pilno zoi)

.i mi galfi le smuni notci:
  - "agape/eros/philia" → zoi gy. agape .gy / zoi gy. eros .gy / zoi gy. philia .gy
  .i tezu'e lo nu ri cmene le si'o prami (pamoicni), le si'o cinse prami, le si'o pendo prami.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 24) — v1375
## (lo ka cumki: fanva zoi gy. necessitates .gy → sarcu)

.i mi galfi le bridi:
  - "nibli" → "sarcu"
  .i tezu'e lo nu zoi gy. necessitates .gy cu se jimpe lo nu sarcu,
    na lo nu nibli po'o.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 25) — v1377
## (krasi: fanva zoi gy. root .gy)

.i mi galfi le bridi:
  - "jicmu be lo lijda nupre" → "krasi be lo lijda nupre"
  .i tezu'e lo nu zoi gy. root .gy cu se jimpe lo nu krasi,
    na lo nu jicmu po'o.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 26) — v1380
## (zoi gy. all the way down .gy: jmina remai prami-bridi)

.i mi galfi le bridi be le pamoi se ciska pagbu:
  - "ze'e lo se vasru be ri." → "gi'e prami ro lo pagbu be ri."
.i seki'u bo lo nu zoi gy. all the way down .gy cu se jimpe lo nu prami lo prenu .e ro lo pagbu be ri,
  .i na lo nu zo ze'e cu se pilno tezu'e lo tcika.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 27) — v1381
## (1 Corinthians: le se cusku be zoi gy. Love is patient... .gy: drani lo smuni .e lo selbri-ckini)

.i mi galfi le bliku be zoi gy. Love is patient.. .gy:
  - "tolxanka denpa" → "na steba" (lo smuni be zoi gy. patient .gy cu simlu lo nu na steba)
  - "na po'o sisku lo nu lo sevzi cu se xamgu" → "na sisku lo se xamgu be ri po'o" (zoi gy. its own benefit .gy)
  - "na sorcu ..." → "na djica lo nu sorcu ..." (jmina le se smuni be zoi gy. want to .gy)
  - "krici/pacna/renvi ro da" → "krici ro lo du'u broda; pacna/renvi ro lo nu broda" (le ro da cu se jmina lo bridi-abstraction)

.i seki'u bo zo steba cu se smuni lo nu x1 cinmo lo ka steba fi x2 (abstraction) .i ja'e bo le bridi "na steba" cu mapti lo se smuni be zoi gy. patient .gy.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 28) — v1382
## (zoi gy. snap your fingers .gy: pilno zo bikla .e zo degji)

.i mi galfi le bridi be le “nelci / prami” se ciska pagbu:
  - "(sei pilno lo nu do sutra sance fi lo do xance toi)"
    → "(sei pilno lo nu lo degji be lo do xance cu bikla toi)"

.i seki'u bo zo bikla cu se smuni lo nu x1 sutra darxi pe'a lo da
  .i .e zo degji cu se smuni lo xadni pagbu poi se srana lo xance .a lo jamfu.
.i ja'e bo le se ciska cu zmadu lo ka drani fi lo se smuni be zoi gy. snap your fingers .gy.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 29) — v1384
## (la'oi Leibniz: na pilno lo “mi”; la'oi cummings: zoi gy. axis .gy = lo midju linji)

.i mi galfi le se ciska be le se cusku be la'o gy. Saint Gottfried Leibniz .gy.:
  - ".i lo nu prami cu du lo nu mi se pluka ..."
    → ".i lo nu prami cu du lo nu ... cu se pluka lo prenu poi prami."
.i seki'u bo mi djica lo nu le se ciksi cu na se srana lo mi po'o
  .i ro prenu poi prami cu kakne lo nu se pluka lo nu lo drata prenu cu se gleki poi se krinu.

.i mi galfi le se ciska be le se cusku be la'o gy. e e cummings .gy.:
  - "lo romli'i pe lo munje" → "lo midju linji pe lo munje"
.i seki'u bo zo linji cu zmadu lo ka drani
  tezu'e lo nu mi'a jimpe lo smuni be lo cmene zoi gy. axis .gy.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 30) — v1385
## (zoi gy. bind/constitute .gy: lasna → jorne)

.i mi galfi le bridi:
  - "mi'a lasna fi lo si'o prami" → "mi'a jorne fi lo si'o prami"
.i seki'u bo zo jorne cu zmadu lo ka drani
  tezu'e lo smuni be zoi gy. bind ourselves with/bind ourselves to .gy.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 31) — v1386
## (ne'i ro lo prenu: vimcu lo pa; klina le smuni be zoi gy. assentive discovery .gy)

.i mi galfi le pamoi cmene be le bridi:
  - "ne'i lo pa prenu" → "ne'i ro lo prenu"
  .i seki'u bo zoi gy. Within individuals .gy na smuni lo si'o pa.

.i mi galfi le remoi bridi:
  - "mi'a tugni gi'e facki lo ka jinzi vamji be lo se prami"
    → "mi'a facki lo du'u lo se prami cu jinzi se vamji gi'e tugni lo du'u ri jinzi se vamji"
  .i seki'u bo le smuni be zoi gy. assentive discovery of intrinsic value .gy cu se jalge lo nu facki .e lo nu tugni.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 32) — v1387
## (la'oi Kant: zoi gy. maxims .gy = le'i javni; pilno zo ja'i)

.i mi galfi le bridi be le se ciska pagbu poi se cusku zoi gy. Love is goodwill.. .gy:
  - "ja'i lo selcmi be lo javni be lo zukte" → "ja'i le'i javni be lo nu mi'a zukte"
  .i seki'u bo zoi gy. maxim .gy cu se jimpe lo javni pe lo zukte .i na lo selcmi po'o.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 33) — v1388
## (la'oi Kempis .e la'oi Anon: klina lo se smuni; stela lo selbri-drata)

.i mi galfi le re ciska se cusku:
  - le Kempis: zoi gy. strives toward more than it attains .gy → "troci lo nu cpacu lo zmadu lo se cpacu be ri"
    .i mi jmina lo se ciska be lo to ... toi tezu'e lo smuni be zoi gy. prima facie .gy
    .i mi stela zo tilju tezu'e zoi gy. burden .gy (lo se tilju pe'a).
  - le Anon: zoi gy. equalizer among egos .gy → "ro lo prenu cu dunli lo ni lo sevzi cu se barda"
    .i mi se jimpe la'oi Ego lo ni lo sevzi cu zmadu lo drata
    .i seki'u bo mi jarco le ni be le'e du'u ri cu se jdika.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 34) — v1389
## (le se ciska pagbu be zoi gy. doxastically voluntaristic .gy: nu→si'o; klina lo bridi; cuxna lo nu krici)

.i mi galfi le bridi be le “se trina cu na banzu” se ciska pagbu:
  - "lo nu prami" → "lo si'o prami"
    .i seki'u bo mi djica lo nu mi skicu lo si'o .i na lo nu fasnu.
  - "prami cu se srana lo nu krici .i ku'i ri se jdice"
    → "prami cu se srana lo nu lo prenu cu cuxna lo nu krici"
    .i seki'u bo mi jarco lo nu prami cu se srana lo cuxna be lo prenu .i na lo nu krici po'o.
.i seki'u bo le selbri-ckini cu klina gi'e frili lo nu se jimpe.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 35) — v1390
## (le se ciska pagbu poi se srana lo munje: vimcu lo na mapti se pilno be lo cmavo fi'o; jmina zoi gy. The Dialetheia .gy .e zoi gy. dialectic .gy; sarxe = na fapro (pe'a))

.i mi galfi le se ciska pagbu:
  - mi pilno "ni'o fi'o se srana ..." tezu'e lo nu mi vimcu lo drata se pilno be lo cmavo fi'o poi na mapti.
  - mi jmina lo cmene be zoi gy. The Dialetheia .gy .e zoi gy. dialectic .gy lo nu ri tcaci.
  - zoi gy. harmonic flatness .gy → "lo nu sarxe .e na fapro (pe'a)"
    .i seki'u bo mi djica lo nu lo smuni cu jarco lo nu fapro cu se vimcu.
.i seki'u bo le se ciska cu zmadu lo ka drani.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 36) — v1393
## (ne'i ro lo prenu; zoi gy. self-creation of will .gy = zo zbasu)

.i mi galfi le se ciska pagbu poi se srana zoi gy. Within individuals.. .gy:
  - "ne'i lo pa prenu" → "ne'i ro lo prenu"
    .i seki'u bo zoi gy. within individuals .gy na smuni lo si'o pa prenu.
  - "finti lo mi'a cuxna" → "zbasu lo mi'a cuxna"
    .i seki'u bo zo zbasu cu zmadu lo ka drani tezu'e lo smuni be zoi gy. self-creation / self-construction .gy.
.i seki'u bo le se ciska cu klina gi'e frili lo nu se jimpe.

# selterpa'i (selterpa'i 37) — v1394
## (ne'i lo cecmu poi kakne lo nu zukte: vimcu lo na mapti se pilno be zo ri; zoi gy. retaliate, yet forgive .gy; zoi gy. perspective decentralization .gy)

.i mi galfi le se ciska pagbu poi se srana zoi gy. Within collective agents.. .gy:
  - "ri se jorne" → "le cecmu cu se jorne"
    .i seki'u bo zo ri pu rinka lo nu se jimpe lo du'u ri = lo si'o prami (na lo cecmu).
  - "venfu gi'e fraxu" → "venfu gi'e ku'i fraxu"
    .i seki'u bo mi djica lo nu se jimpe zoi gy. retaliate, yet forgive .gy.

.i seki'u bo le official-ish spine cu mapti banzu: zo si'o cu jgari concept-abstraction rather than event-abstraction, zo prami cu jgari zoi gy. x1 loves x2 .gy, zo pendo cu jgari zoi gy. x1 is a friend to x2 .gy, zo jmina cu jgari zoi gy. x1 adds/combines x2 to/with x3, with result x4 .gy, zo sisti cu jgari zoi gy. x1 stops x2 .gy, .e zo mapti cu jgari zoi gy. x1 fits/suits x2 by standard x3 .gy. .i ja'e bo le current wording cu tcila-klina banzu tezu'e le source intention: agape is rendered na ku as a third disconnected thing, ku'i as the fitting one-out-of-two-through-sublation shape in which eros-love and philia-love are fused into one and cease to stand merely opposed. .i mi na galfi le live wording ca le turn.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: moral luck

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked phrase for "moral luck" is best read inside the entry:

`lo si'o funca poi se srana lo marde`

Companion gloss:

The phrase should be read as the concept of luck or fortune insofar as it is ethically or morally relevant. In the argument of the entry, the point is not that love is itself arbitrary, but that fully realized justified flourishing still depends on morally relevant contingency beyond the agent's direct control.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `si'o` keeps the phrase at the level of a philosophical concept, not one lucky event.
- `funca` keeps the luck / fortune axis explicit without pretending Lojban has a perfectly ready-made canonical compound for the English term.
- `poi se srana lo marde` keeps the notion morally qualified rather than merely lucky in a casual or hedonistic sense.

So the best reading remains: moral luck as ethically relevant fortune or contingency affecting the realization of justified eudaimonic completion.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: justification itself

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked hinge sentence about justification is best read inside the entry:

`.i ku'i lo si'o prami cu banzu tezu'e lo nu se krinu ki'u lo nu ri du lo si'o krinu.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as saying that love satisfies the demands of justification not by being one further external reason among others, but by occupying the very conceptual place of justification in the entry's moral architecture. In other words, the claim is not merely that love happens to be justified; it is that love is what makes justification finally land.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `banzu` preserves the sufficiency claim cleanly: love is enough with respect to justification.
- `lo nu se krinu` keeps the target on the axis of being justified / having reasons.
- `ki'u lo nu ri du lo si'o krinu` preserves the strongest part of the source sentence: love is sufficient for justification because it is identified with justification at the conceptual level.
- `lo si'o krinu` keeps the final claim properly at the level of concept or idea, rather than reducing it to one isolated reason or explanation event.

So the best reading remains: love is not only something that can be justified; love is the concept-level reality in virtue of which justification is fulfilled.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: binding and constituting ourselves with love

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked hinge sentence about binding and constituting ourselves with love is best read inside the entry:

`.i ja'e bo lo nu mi'a jorne lo si'o prami .e lo nu lo si'o prami cu zbasu lo mi'a se zasti cu banzu tezu'e lo nu mi'a snada lo fanmo be lo marde zukte poi se srana lo tcini be mi'a.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as saying that joining ourselves to love, and being constituted by love, is sufficient for the successful realization of the context-shaped telos of moral agency. The point is not merely that love accompanies moral action; the point is that love binds the agent and helps make the agent into the kind of being for whom the right moral end can actually be achieved.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `jorne` keeps the force of binding / joining without pretending the English requires a more legalistic bond word.
- `zbasu lo mi'a se zasti` preserves the constitutive force: love is not only something we have, but something that helps make what we are as moral agents.
- `banzu tezu'e lo nu mi'a snada` keeps the sufficiency claim explicit and strong.
- `lo fanmo be lo marde zukte poi se srana lo tcini be mi'a` still preserves the dense source claim that the end or telos in view is morally practical and context-particular, not one flat universal outcome detached from situation.

So the best reading remains: binding ourselves with love and being constituted by love is enough for achieving the contextually particular telos proper to moral agency, even if that does not guarantee complete eudaimonic fulfillment.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: agape / eros / philia

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about agape as the fitting sublational fusion of eros and philia is best read inside the entry:

`.i lo si'o prami cu du pe'a zoi gy. agape .gy.`
`.i ri du lo nu lo si'o cinse prami .e lo si'o pendo prami cu se jmina gi'e binxo lo pa gi'e sisti lo nu lo si'o cinse prami cu dukti lo si'o pendo prami kei poi mapti fa la'oi irwartfrr.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as saying that love, at the level of the individual person, is best understood as agape: not a third disconnected form alongside eros and philia, but the fitting one-through-sublation in which erotic love and friendship-love are joined into one and cease merely to stand opposed. The point is not to erase their difference at the start, but to let that difference be taken up into a higher unity that is morally fitting.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `si'o` keeps the sentence at the level of concepts or kinds of love rather than isolated episodes.
- `cinse prami` and `pendo prami` keep the two poles distinct enough for the sublational structure to remain visible.
- `se jmina gi'e binxo lo pa` preserves the fusion-into-one movement.
- `sisti lo nu ... cu dukti ...` keeps the crucial pressure that opposition is not merely ignored, but in an important sense ceases as opposition in the resulting unity.
- `mapti fa la'oi irwartfrr` keeps the unity normatively fitted, not merely psychologically blended.

So the best reading remains: agape as the morally fitting unification in which eros and philia are fused and no longer remain merely contraries.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: assentive discovery of intrinsic value / self-creation of will

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about assentive discovery of intrinsic value and the self-creation of our will is best read inside the entry:

`.i lo si'o prami cu du lo nu mi'a facki fi lo ni lo se prami cu vamji kei gi'e tugni lo du'u lo ka ce'u vamji lo se prami kei cu jinzi lo se prami .e lo nu mi'a zbasu lo zifre cuxna be mi'a tezu'e lo se prami.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as making a two-sided claim about love. On one side, love discovers and assents to the beloved's intrinsic value: it finds that the beloved matters, and agrees that this value belongs to the beloved as something inherent rather than merely projected. On the other side, love is also active self-formation: it is the making of our own free choosing orientation toward that value. So the line is neither pure passive recognition nor pure arbitrary self-assertion; it is both assentive discovery and willed self-creation.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `facki fi lo ni lo se prami cu vamji` preserves the discovery or finding-out side of the sentence.
- `tugni lo du'u ... cu jinzi lo se prami` preserves the assentive and intrinsic side: the value is agreed to as belonging naturally or inherently to the beloved.
- `jinzi` remains the best baseline gismu for intrinsic or inherent property.
- `zbasu lo zifre cuxna be mi'a tezu'e lo se prami` preserves the active self-creative side, where our own will or free choice is made toward the beloved rather than merely found already complete.

So the best reading remains: love both recognizes intrinsic value in the beloved and forms our own will toward that value.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: morally justified cause and emergent consequence of the sublation of contraries

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about love as a morally justified cause and emergent consequence of the sublation of contraries is best read inside the entry:

`.i lo si'o prami cu du lo rinka poi se krinu lo nu ke'a drani fo lo marde .e lo jalge poi se jbena lo nu loi dukti cu se jmina gi'e binxo lo pa gi'e sisti lo nu lo pagbu be ri cu dukti lo drata pagbu be ri.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as making a double claim about love. On the one hand, love is a morally justified cause: it can itself bring about the overcoming of opposition in a way that is right by moral standard. On the other hand, love is also an emergent consequence of that same overcoming: when contraries are taken up into a fitting unity and do not remain merely opposed, love can appear as the result of that process as well. So the line is not saying only that love resolves contraries, nor only that love comes after their resolution. It says both.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `lo rinka poi se krinu lo nu ke'a drani fo lo marde` keeps the causal side explicitly tied to moral justification rather than mere efficiency.
- `lo jalge poi se jbena ...` keeps the emergent-consequence side visible and distinct from the causal side.
- `loi dukti cu se jmina gi'e binxo lo pa` preserves the sublational movement as a becoming-one rather than a mere compromise.
- `sisti lo nu lo pagbu be ri cu dukti lo drata pagbu be ri` keeps the crucial pressure that the opposed parts do not simply disappear, but cease to remain merely opposed in the resulting unity.

So the best reading remains: love is both a morally justified cause of the overcoming of contraries and a consequence born from that same fitted overcoming.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: collective agents / forgiving retaliation / perspective decentralization

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about collective agents, forgiving retaliation, and perspective decentralization is best read inside the entry:

`.i lo si'o prami cu du lo nu loi pagbu be le gunma cu jorne loi drata pagbu be le gunma
  sepi'o lo ka ce'u vlipa lo nu venfu ta'i lo nu fraxu kei be le gunma
    .e sepi'o lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju kei be lo te jvinu pe le gunma.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as saying that, at the level of collective agency, love is a unifying power. But it does not unify merely by suppressing force, nor merely by forgetting wrong. It unifies through a power that can retaliate and yet forgive, and through a decentering of the group’s own perspective so that the collective does not remain locked in its own self-centered point of view.

In other words, the line is not pacifist in the thin sense and not triumphalist in the thin sense. It says that love, within groups, makes it possible to answer conflict with force that is still shaped by forgiveness, and to answer perspective with a stance that is no longer simply centered on the collective self.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `gunma` keeps the sentence on the level of a collective agent or aggregate rather than reducing it to one person.
- `jorne loi drata pagbu be le gunma` preserves the unifying force as joining parts of the collective to one another.
- `vlipa lo nu venfu ta'i lo nu fraxu` keeps the paradoxical power clear: retaliation is not denied, but it is normatively reshaped through forgiveness.
- `na'e sevzi se midju` keeps the decentralization scalar rather than absolute; the point is not the annihilation of perspective, but its becoming less self-centered.
- `lo te jvinu pe le gunma` keeps the perspective side explicitly collective rather than merely individual.

So the best reading remains: within collective agents, love unifies by means of forgivingly retaliating power and by decentering the collective perspective away from self-centeredness.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: existence of love necessitates contingency

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about the existence of love necessitating contingency is best read inside the entry:

`.i ja'e bo lo du'u lo si'o prami cu zasti cu nibli lo du'u su'o se fasnu cu cumki gi'e na sarcu`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as saying that if love exists, then reality cannot be exhaustively necessary. The existence of love implies that at least some things must be genuinely possible otherwise: some states of affairs must be able to occur without being logically or metaphysically forced. So the line cashes out “contingency” not by importing a single technical calque, but by spelling it out in Lojbanic modal terms as possibility together with non-necessity.

In other words, the sentence is not merely saying that love happens in uncertain circumstances. It is saying something stronger about the structure of reality presupposed by love: love requires a world in which not everything is fixed by necessity.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `lo du'u lo si'o prami cu zasti` keeps the claim at the level of the existence of love as a conceptually real condition, not merely one local loving-event.
- `nibli` preserves the necessitating or entailment force between the existence of love and the modal consequence that follows.
- `su'o se fasnu cu cumki` keeps the possibility side explicit in straightforward Lojbanic terms.
- `gi'e na sarcu` prevents that possibility from collapsing back into necessity, which is exactly what the English “contingency” is trying to preserve.
- The whole sentence remains more honest and more canonical-ish than a forced one-word calque for “contingency” would be.

So the best reading remains: the existence of love entails that some aspects of reality are contingent, that is, possible and not necessary.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: leap into love rather than fall into it

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about leaping into love rather than falling into it is best read inside the entry:

`.i fi lo smuni: do na kakne lo nu co'a prami ta'i lo nu pe'a farlu fe ri ki'u lo nu do pe'a plipe fe ri cu sarcu.`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as making a claim about the structure of beginning to love. It says that, conceptually, love is not best understood as something that merely happens to us like an accidental fall. Instead, the beginning of love has the shape of a leap: a committed movement into something that is not simply passive, even if it includes risk, loss of footing, or vulnerability.

So the line does not deny that love can feel sudden or destabilizing. Rather, it says that if we are thinking clearly about what love is, its initiation belongs more to chosen commitment than to mere collapse into a state.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `fi lo smuni` keeps the sentence explicitly on the conceptual or interpretive level rather than turning it into a psychological report.
- `co'a prami` preserves the force of beginning-to-love rather than the whole duration of loving.
- `pe'a farlu` keeps the metaphorical fall-image without forcing it into literal event-description.
- `pe'a plipe` keeps the leap-image equally metaphorical and active.
- `sarcu` preserves the claim that the leap-side is not optional to the concept being argued for.

So the best reading remains: you do not simply fall into love; properly understood, you must leap into it.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: self-love, selflessness, and loving others all the way down

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about self-love, selflessness, and loving others all the way down is best read inside the entry:

`.i ganai do jetnu prami lo do sevzi kei do ba banzu lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju tezu'e lo nu do prami ro lo'e drata prenu gi'e prami ro lo pagbu be ri`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as saying that genuine self-love does not culminate in self-enclosure. Rather, if you truly love yourself, that love should make you non-self-centered enough to love other persons as well, and not just superficially or in the aggregate, but all the way down into their constitutive levels or parts.

So the line is not opposing self-love to love of others. It is arguing that rightly ordered self-love flowers into a less self-centered stance, and that this stance is sufficient for a deeper and more thoroughgoing love of others.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `jetnu prami lo do sevzi` keeps the first half explicitly on the axis of true or genuine self-love rather than mere self-preference.
- `banzu lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju` preserves the idea of being sufficiently non-self-centered, with `na'e` keeping the scalar “other than self-centered” force rather than a blunt contradiction.
- `tezu'e lo nu do prami ro lo'e drata prenu` keeps the transition from self-love to love of others as a practical consequence or enabling condition.
- `gi'e prami ro lo pagbu be ri` preserves the force of “all the way down” better than a flatter paraphrase would; the point is not just loving others in general, but loving them through all their relevant parts or layers.
- The sentence remains more faithful than a softened version would be, because the original line is trying to connect self-love, selflessness, and thoroughgoing love of others in one movement.

So the best reading remains: if you really love yourself, you become non-self-centered enough to love others deeply and all the way down.

## Post-lock companion gloss note: suffering for those who do not deserve it

This pass adds no new Lojban wording. It records how the locked sentence about suffering for those who do not deserve it is best read inside the entry:

`.i ko cortu .i ji'a ko cortu mu'i lo nu do sidju lo prenu poi na selva'i lo nu se cortu kei; .i ti cu pa lo fanmo cipra be lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu po'e ri`

Companion gloss:

The sentence should be read as an exhortation not only to endure suffering oneself, but also to accept suffering that comes from aiding those who do not deserve to suffer. The point is not that suffering is intrinsically good. The point is that goodwill is finally tested by whether it remains active even when it costs us something on behalf of the undeserving.

So the line is trying to say something harsher and more demanding than mere sympathy. It is saying that one of the final proofs of goodwill is a willingness to bear pain in solidarity with, or in defense of, people whose suffering would be unjust.

Why the locked wording still stands:

- `ko cortu` keeps the imperative force of the opening without over-explaining it into a weaker suggestion.
- `ji'a ko cortu mu'i lo nu do sidju lo prenu poi na selva'i lo nu se cortu` keeps the second suffering explicitly tied to helping persons who do not deserve suffering, rather than making it generic or merely parallel.
- `selva'i` preserves the worthiness direction correctly: the persons in question are not worthy of being made to suffer.
- `pa lo fanmo cipra` keeps the sense that this is one among the final or last tests, not the whole of goodwill.
- `lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu po'e ri` keeps the line anchored on goodwill itself as the thing being tested.
- The sentence remains stronger and truer to the source than a softened paraphrase would be, because the original is deliberately morally severe.

So the best reading remains: suffer, and even suffer because you help those who do not deserve suffering; that willingness is one of the final tests of goodwill itself.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2298

### On “Joy is at least nearly selfless”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo nu gleki cu jibni lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that joy, or the state/event of being joyful, comes close to a non-self-centered form of stance or orientation. It is not claiming that every instance of happiness is perfectly altruistic. It is making the gentler and more plausible claim that joy, at least in the morally relevant sense intended by the entry, tends toward selflessness or away from self-enclosure.

Why the wording still stands:

- `lo nu gleki` keeps the line on the event/state axis of joy rather than turning it into a flat timeless property-word.

- `fatci` keeps the second half on the truth-as-fact axis, which suits the archive’s wider concern with justification, reality, and objective dignity.

So the best reading remains: love does not rejoice in moral wrongness, but does rejoice in truth.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2312

For this pass, no live Lojban wording was changed.

### On Lacan: “I love you, but, because inexplicably I love in you something more than you—the objet petit a—I mutilate you.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i mi prami do `
` .i ku'i ki'u lo nu mi na kakne lo nu ciksi kei mi prami su'o da poi se srana do gi'e da zmadu do lo ka ce'u vajni mi gi'e da na du do `
` .i le su'o da cu du zoi gy. objet petit a .gy `
` .i ja'e bo mi xrani do gi'e katna su'o pagbu be lo do xadni `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as a deliberately violent and split account of desire inside love. It says: I love you, but what I love in you is not simply identical with you; there is something in relation to you that exceeds you in importance for me, and because of that excess-object, I injure or mutilate you. So the line preserves the disturbing claim that a misdirected or overdetermined love can wound the beloved precisely because it is attached to something more than the beloved as such.

Why the wording still stands:

- `mi prami do` keeps the opening direct and unsoftened.
- `mi na kakne lo nu ciksi` preserves the line’s own avowal that the structure is not readily explainable.
- `su'o da poi se srana do` keeps the “something in you / in relation to you” deliberately indeterminate rather than falsely over-defined.
- `da zmadu do lo ka ce'u vajni mi gi'e da na du do` preserves the crucial structure that the extra object matters more to the speaker than the beloved and is not identical with the beloved.
- Keeping `zoi gy. objet petit a .gy` untranslated is still the right decision here; forcing a calque would lose the specifically Lacanian charge.
- `xrani` and `katna` keep the close genuinely violent rather than making it merely metaphorical or emotionally diluted.

So the best reading remains: the beloved is loved, but the love is warped by attachment to an excess-object that is not simply the beloved, and that distortion becomes injurious.

### On “it is intentionality which sacrificially overrides all other reasons, including our own happiness.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i ri du lo menli tcini poi platu lo nu zukte (to pe'a zoi gy. intentionality .gy toi) gi'e rinka lo nu le'i drata mukti cu se vimcu fi lo nu zukte ta'i lo nu dunda lo se banzu be lo sevzi lo drata. `
` .i ji'a lo nu mi'a gleki cu cmima le'i drata mukti poi se vimcu fi lo nu zukte. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that love, in its intentional form, can reorder action so radically that competing motives lose governing force. The point is not that happiness ceases to matter in every sense. The point is that love can give action a sacrificial direction in which other motives, including concern for our own happiness, no longer rule.

Why the wording still stands:

- `lo menli tcini poi platu lo nu zukte` keeps intentionality on the axis of a mental directedness that organizes action.
- `le'i drata mukti cu se vimcu fi lo nu zukte` preserves the key claim that other motives are removed from control over action, not necessarily annihilated as psychological facts.
- `ta'i lo nu dunda lo se banzu be lo sevzi lo drata` keeps the sacrificial force by framing the override through giving enough of oneself to others.
- `lo nu mi'a gleki cu cmima le'i drata mukti poi se vimcu fi lo nu zukte` keeps the difficult final clause explicit: even our own happiness can fall among the motives displaced from governance.
- The two-sentence structure still matters because it first states the general override of other reasons and then sharpens the claim by naming our own happiness as included.

So the best reading remains: love is not merely one motive among others, but a form of intentional directedness that can sacrificially deprioritize even our own happiness when action is governed by the right relation to others.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2319

### On “Love is so robust and radical it defies our explanation without losing justification.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o prami cu mutce stali gi'e mutce se srana lo krasi .i ja'e bo lo nu mi'a ciksi ri cu mutce nandu gi'e ku'i ri na cirko lo krinu. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that love is both enduringly firm and deeply rooted, and that precisely because of this depth it resists being fully captured by our explanations. The point is not that love lacks reasons. The point is that explanatory difficulty does not strip love of justification.

Why the wording still stands:

- `mutce stali` keeps the robust or abiding force without flattening it into mere stubbornness.
- `mutce se srana lo krasi` keeps the radical force on the axis of roots, origin, or depth rather than on mere extremity.
- `lo nu mi'a ciksi ri cu mutce nandu` preserves the claim that explanation is difficult for us, not that explanation is in principle meaningless.
- `gi'e ku'i ri na cirko lo krinu` keeps the crucial asymmetry: love can resist explanation without losing justificatory force.
- The compact sentence still matters because it preserves the source’s contrast between explanatory resistance and justificatory standing instead of over-spelling it into a different thesis.

So the best reading remains: love is robust and radical enough to outstrip our explanatory grasp, yet it does not thereby become unjustified or arbitrary.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2320

For this pass, no live Lojban wording was changed.

### On “Love is not merely an appraisal: it is autonomous recognition of objective dignity which merits all subjective respect.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o prami na po'o du lo si'o pajni. .i ri du lo nu lo prenu cu sevzi jitro gi'e facki fi lo ni lo drata prenu cu vamji kei poi na se srana lo te jvinu. .i lo ni lo drata prenu cu vamji kei cu sarcu lo nu da sinma ri ta'i lo ka ce'u se srana lo te jvinu. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that love is not exhausted by judging, evaluating, or appraising another. It is a self-governed recognition that the other possesses worth in a way that does not depend on the lover’s perspective, and that such worth calls for respect from any subjective standpoint.

Why the wording still stands:

- `na po'o du lo si'o pajni` keeps the crucial “not merely an appraisal” force without denying that appraisal can be involved.
- `sevzi jitro` keeps the autonomy or self-governed force rather than making recognition merely passive.
- `facki fi lo ni lo drata prenu cu vamji` preserves the discovery or recognition of worth.
- `poi na se srana lo te jvinu` keeps the worth objective in the intended sense: not relative to a viewpoint.
- `cu sarcu lo nu da sinma ri ta'i lo ka ce'u se srana lo te jvinu` preserves the final claim that such dignity merits respect from within subjective standpoints rather than abolishing subjectivity altogether.
- The three-part movement still matters: first denying reduction to appraisal, then stating recognition of objective worth, then stating the demand for respect that follows from it.

So the best reading remains: love is more than a verdict; it is autonomous recognition of objective worth, and that worth normatively calls for subjective respect.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2321

For this pass, no live Lojban wording was changed.

### On “Unjustified love is merely the ill-informed appearance of attraction as love.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o prami poi na se krinu cu po'o du lo si'o trina poi simlu lo si'o prami ta'i lo nu na se djuno fi lo krinu. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that unjustified love is not truly love in the full moral sense intended by the entry. Rather, it is attraction which only appears as love because the relevant justificatory grounds are absent or unknown. The point is not that attraction is unreal; the point is that attraction by itself can masquerade as love when justification is missing.

Why the wording still stands:

- `lo si'o prami poi na se krinu` keeps the target on love that lacks justification, rather than on love in general.
- `po'o du` preserves the “merely” force: such a case is only this lesser thing.
- `lo si'o trina` keeps attraction at the concept level, matching the broader discourse of the paragraph.
- `poi simlu lo si'o prami` preserves the appearance-structure: attraction seeming to be love.
- `ta'i lo nu na se djuno fi lo krinu` keeps the failure specifically on the axis of missing or unknown justification, not just on the axis of weak feeling or bad outcomes.
- The compactness still matters because the line is meant to sharply distinguish attraction from morally justified love without dissolving the real phenomenological resemblance between them.

So the best reading remains: unjustified “love” is really attraction wearing the appearance of love when the justificatory grounds are missing or not known.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2322

For this pass, no live Lojban wording was changed.

### On “To love is not to like because, unlike likingness, love is up to us.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o prami na du lo si'o nelci. `  
` .i ki'u bo lo prenu na ka'e jitro lo si'o nelci .i ku'i lo prenu cu ka'e jitro lo si'o prami. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as a distinction between two different kinds of relation to another. Liking is treated as something that is not directly under our control in the same way, while love is treated as something over which agency, commitment, and governance can actually be exercised. So the claim is not that liking is unreal or unimportant. The claim is that love belongs more properly to the sphere of responsibility.

Why the wording still stands:

- `lo si'o prami na du lo si'o nelci` keeps the conceptual distinction sharp without pretending love and liking never overlap phenomenologically.
- `na ka'e jitro lo si'o nelci` preserves the claim that liking is not straightforwardly governable at will.
- `lo prenu cu ka'e jitro lo si'o prami` keeps the line’s strongest normative thesis: love is something a person can govern, undertake, or commit themselves to.
- Keeping both `nelci` and `prami` at the `si'o` level matches the whole paragraph’s concept-level argument rather than reducing the line to one isolated case.
- The compact asymmetry still matters because the sentence is doing philosophical work: it is separating affection as felt fondness from love as volitional moral orientation.

So the best reading remains: liking may happen to us, but love is something we can be responsible for.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2323

For this pass, no live Lojban wording was changed.

### On “Attraction is not sufficient.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o trina cu na banzu tezu'e lo si'o prami. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as a deliberately austere threshold claim. Attraction is real, and attraction may be one important component in how love begins or presents itself, but attraction by itself does not yet amount to love in the fuller moral sense intended by the entry. The sentence therefore functions as a gate: whatever else love is, simple attraction alone does not meet the standard.

Why the wording still stands:

- `lo si'o trina` keeps attraction at the concept level, matching the paragraph’s broader philosophical register.
- `na banzu` preserves the exact insufficiency claim without saying attraction is false, evil, or worthless.
- `tezu'e lo si'o prami` keeps the purpose or standard explicit: the question is whether attraction suffices *for love*.
- The sentence gains force from its brevity; a longer paraphrase would weaken the threshold-like role it plays in the argument.
- The compact line also lets the surrounding sentences do their proper work: attraction may be present, but choice, intention, effort, and justification are still needed for love.

So the best reading remains: attraction can matter, but attraction alone does not suffice for love.

- `do ka'e cuxna lo nu do prami da` keeps the contrast exact: love remains on the side of choice even where liking does not.
- The two-sentence structure still matters, because the first half denies direct command over liking while the second half preserves moral agency in relation to love.

So the best reading remains: you cannot summon liking at once by fiat, but you can still choose to love.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2325

For this pass, no live Lojban wording was changed.

### On “Love is doxastically voluntaristic; it is a matter of intention and effort.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o prami cu se srana lo nu lo prenu cu ka'e cuxna lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u krici .a lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u zukte. `  
` .i ri se srana lo si'o mukti poi lo prenu cu cuxna ke'a tezu'e lo nu zukte .e lo si'o troci poi se srana lo nu zukte. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as placing love on the side of guided agency rather than mere passive attraction or spontaneous feeling. “Doxastically voluntaristic” here means that love involves a dimension of what one commits one’s belief-orientation and action-orientation to, rather than being something wholly outside the reach of will. The second sentence makes that more concrete: love is a matter of intention and effort.

Why the wording still stands:

- `krici` keeps the line on the belief-orientation side without narrowing it to certainty or proof.
- `cuxna` preserves the voluntaristic force by keeping choice explicit.
- `se stika lo ka ce'u krici .a lo nu se stika lo ka ce'u zukte` keeps the sentence suspended between belief-side direction and action-side direction, which fits the source better than collapsing it into only one of the two.
- `lo si'o mukti` keeps intention on the motivational-concept axis rather than reducing it to one passing urge.
- `lo si'o troci poi se srana lo nu zukte` preserves effort as something tied to doing, exertion, and enacted practice.
- The two-sentence structure still matters, because the first half states the abstract thesis while the second half interprets it in more ordinary practical terms.

So the best reading remains: love is not merely something that happens to us; it involves willed orientation in belief and action, and therefore belongs to intention and effort.

- `lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu` still works best in this archive as the concept-level carrier of goodwill.

### On “Love is a commitment to The Right, and hence it is our responsibility.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i lo si'o prami cu du lo si'o nupre fe lo nu mi'a tinbe lo si'o drani. `  
` .i ja'e bo ri du lo si'o fuzme fe lo nu mi'a tinbe lo si'o drani. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that love binds us to The Right not merely as a feeling or attraction, but as a commitment that places us under obligation. The first sentence gives love the shape of a pledge or undertaking toward what is right. The second sentence then draws the consequence: because love has that structure, it belongs to the sphere of responsibility.

Why the wording still stands:

- `fe lo nu mi'a tinbe lo si'o drani` keeps the committed content explicit: what is undertaken is following or adhering to The Right.
- `lo si'o drani` still works best in this archive as the protected carrier for **The Right**, keeping the line on the right/correct/proper axis rather than collapsing it into generic goodness.
- `lo si'o fuzme` preserves responsibility in the sense of answerability or being responsible for the committed content.
- Keeping the same `fe lo nu mi'a tinbe lo si'o drani` structure in both sentences matters, because it shows that responsibility is not being added from outside; it grows directly out of the same commitment-content named in the first line.
- The two-sentence structure still matters, because the first half states what love *is* in relation to The Right, while the second states what therefore follows for us.

So the best reading remains: love is a commitment to The Right, and therefore it is something for which we are responsible.

## Companion-gloss note added in v2328

### On “Love is the moral motivation that acts only on those maxims which assume The Other as an end in themselves in this possible world.”

Locked Lojban:

` .i ri du lo si'o mukti fe lo nu mi'a zukte fi mi'a poi se srana lo marde. `  
` .i ku'i ri rinka po'o lo nu mi'a zukte ja'i le'i javni poi mi'a cuxna ke'a tezu'e lo nu mi'a zukte gi'e sruma bu'u le munje poi cumki lo du'u lo drata prenu cu fanmo po'o be le nu mi'a zukte gi'e na du lo tutci be lo nu mi'a snada. `

Best current reading:

This line should be read as saying that love is not just any motive for action, but specifically a moral motivation. It only permits action through those chosen principles or maxims that treat the other person as an end in themselves within a possible world, and not merely as an instrument for our own success.

Why the wording still stands:

- `lo si'o mukti` keeps the line on the axis of motivation rather than flattening it into a bare cause.
- `lo nu mi'a zukte fi mi'a poi se srana lo marde` preserves the specifically moral character of the motivating relation.
- `ja'i le'i javni poi mi'a cuxna ke'a tezu'e lo nu mi'a zukte` keeps the maxim-or-principle structure explicit, rather than paraphrasing it away.
- `sruma bu'u le munje poi cumki` preserves the possible-world frame without pretending the source only means the actual world.
- `lo drata prenu cu fanmo po'o be le nu mi'a zukte gi'e na du lo tutci be lo nu mi'a snada` keeps the Kantian end-versus-means contrast sharp: the other is assumed as an end of our action, not merely as a tool of our success.
- The two-sentence structure still matters, because the first line states the abstract role of love as moral motivation, while the second line spells out the constraint on the maxims through which that motivation may act.

So the best reading remains: love is the moral motivation that guides action only through maxims that treat the other as an end, not merely as a means.

   - Reading: love as the primary moral-law disposition on the axes of possibility and necessity.

6. **Existence of love necessitates contingency**
   - Locked core: `.i ja'e bo lo du'u lo si'o prami cu zasti cu nibli lo du'u su'o se fasnu cu cumki gi'e na sarcu.`
   - Reading: if love exists, not everything can be exhaustively necessary.

7. **Leap into love, not fall into it**
   - Locked core: `.i fi lo smuni: do na kakne lo nu co'a prami ta'i lo nu pe'a farlu fe ri ki'u lo nu do pe'a plipe fe ri cu sarcu.`
   - Reading: beginning to love has the structure of committed leap rather than passive accident.

8. **Attraction not sufficient; liking not controllable in the same way as love**
   - Locked core: `.i lo si'o trina cu na banzu tezu'e lo si'o prami. .i lo si'o prami na du lo si'o nelci.`
   - Reading: attraction and liking matter, but neither yet equals love in the full moral sense.

9. **Love not merely appraisal but recognition of objective dignity**
   - Locked core: `.i lo si'o prami na po'o du lo si'o pajni ... gi'e facki fi lo ni lo drata prenu cu vamji ...`
   - Reading: love as autonomous recognition of worth that calls for respect.

10. **Love as justification itself / binding and constituting us**
    - Locked core: `.i ku'i lo si'o prami cu banzu tezu'e lo nu se krinu ki'u lo nu ri du lo si'o krinu.`
    - Also: `.i ja'e bo lo nu mi'a jorne lo si'o prami .e lo nu lo si'o prami cu zbasu lo mi'a se zasti cu banzu tezu'e lo nu mi'a snada lo fanmo be lo marde zukte poi se srana lo tcini be mi'a.`
    - Reading: love as sufficient for justification and as constitutive of moral agency.

This third index is meant to make the archive easier to use as a working map of the main prose argument, not just of the quote clusters or the densest metaphysical lines.

## Post-lock refinement note (v2334): Fourth compact companion-gloss index for glossary terms and footnotes

This pass adds a fourth quick-reference index for the **glossary terms, acronym-definitions, and footnote-level hinge remarks** so that the archive can now be navigated not only by main prose and quote cluster, but also by the smaller commentary-bearing units that shape how the entry is to be read.

1. **`irwartfrr`**
   - Locked core: `la'oi irwartfrr du lo nu zukte ta'i lo drani tadji .e ca lo nu lo drani tcika .e mu'i lo nu lo drani mukti.`
   - Reading: the fitting; in the right way, at the right time, for the right reasons.

2. **`irwrongfrr`**
   - Locked core: `la'oi irwrongfrr du lo nu zukte ta'i lo to'e drani tadji .e ca lo nu lo to'e drani tcika .e mu'i lo nu lo to'e drani mukti.`
   - Reading: the opposite of the fitting; wrong way, wrong time, wrong reasons.

3. **Footnote `af`: picky about words**
   - Locked core: `.i mi ba mutce seljundi lo se cusku be mi .i je'u mi ba mutce seljundi lo nu mi cuxna lo valsi poi mi pilno tezu'e lo ka satci.`
   - Reading: a meta-linguistic declaration of precision in wording.

4. **Footnote `inl`: being in love / feeling loved / loving**
   - Locked core: `.i mi badri lo nu so'i prenu cu selva'i po'o lo nu ri co'a prami ... .i ku'i ri na selva'i lo nu ri prami.`
   - Reading: a distinction between affective states around love and the active practice of loving.

5. **Footnote `tr`: love not reducible to trust or respect**
   - Locked core: `.i lo si'o prami na po'o du lo si'o lacri le se prami .a lo si'o sinma ...`
   - Reading: trust and esteem may belong to love, but do not exhaust it.

6. **Footnote `i`: even if we can only point**
   - Locked core: `.i ku'i sarcu lo nu mi'a troci lo nu tavla fi lo si'o prami gi'e troci lo nu ciksi lo si'o prami gi'e troci lo nu ciksi fi lo krinu be lo si'o prami. .i ku'i cumki fa lo nu mi'a ka'e po'o jarco tu'a lo si'o prami.`
   - Reading: love must still be communicated and justified even if full verbal capture is impossible.

7. **Footnote `eu`: no unjustified complete eudaimonia as a person**
   - Locked core: `.i na zasti lo nu lo prenu cu mulno fi lo ka zoi gy. eudaimonia .gy gi'e na se krinu. ...`
   - Reading: full flourishing for persons remains tied to justification, even under moral luck.

8. **Footnote `g`: goodwill unconditionally good**
   - Locked core: `.i lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu cu xamgu. .i no tcini cu sarcu lo nu lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu cu xamgu.`
   - Reading: goodwill is good without requiring further condition.

This fourth index is meant to make the archive easier to use as a scholarly working text, especially when a later reader wants to revisit the conceptual side-remarks and meta-comments without searching through the entire document.

## Post-lock refinement note (v2335): Fifth compact companion-gloss index for the opening prose arc

This pass adds a fifth quick-reference index for the **opening prose arc** so that the archive can now be navigated not only by metaphysical hinge lines, quote clusters, main argumentative pivots, and footnotes, but also by the opening invocatory and exhortative lines that establish the tone of the whole entry.

1. **The word `prami` as explanatory key**
   - Locked core: `.i le valsi zo prami cu ciksi so'i dacti fi la'o gy. The Great Human Conversation .gy`
   - Reading: the word *prami* is treated as a deep explanatory key within the larger human discourse.

2. **If you really love yourself, you will be self-less enough to love others all the way down**
   - Locked core: `.i ganai do jetnu prami lo do sevzi kei do ba banzu lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju tezu'e lo nu do prami ro lo'e drata prenu gi'e prami ro lo pagbu be ri`
   - Reading: genuine self-love should open outward into non-self-centered love of others, and of their relevant parts or layers.

3. **Picking out the salience of love**
   - Locked core: `.i mi pacna lo nu mi kakne lo nu facki fi lo si'o vajni be lo si'o prami ta'i lo ka'e be mi`
   - Reading: the speaker hopes to discern and indicate the conceptual importance of love as well as they can.

4. **Consider the fall a part of the leap**
   - Locked core: `.i ko jinvi lo du'u lo nu farlu cu pagbu lo nu plipe`
   - Reading: destabilization or loss can belong to the larger committed motion of leaping.

5. **Suffer for those who do not deserve it**
   - Locked core: `.i ko cortu .i ji'a ko cortu mu'i lo nu do sidju lo prenu poi na selva'i lo nu se cortu kei; .i ti cu pa lo fanmo cipra be lo si'o cuxna lo xamgu po'e ri`
   - Reading: goodwill is tested by whether it persists even when helping the undeserving costs us pain.

6. **May we be worthy of what happiness we find**
   - Locked core: `.i a'o mi'a selva'i lo nu mi'a gleki poi mi'a facki fi ke'a.`
   - Reading: the wish is not merely for happiness, but for deserving the happiness that comes.

7. **Joy is at least nearly selfless**
   - Locked core: `.i lo nu gleki cu jibni lo ka ce'u na'e sevzi se midju.`
   - Reading: morally relevant joy tends away from self-enclosure and toward non-self-centeredness.

This fifth index is meant to make the archive easier to use as a map of the opening tonal and exhortative movement of the entry, not only of its later philosophical machinery.

## Post-lock refinement note (v2336): Sixth compact companion-gloss index for the major scriptural quotation blocks

This pass adds a sixth quick-reference index for the **major scriptural quotation blocks**, so that the archive can now be navigated not only by metaphysical hinge lines, quote clusters, main argumentative pivots, footnotes, and opening prose, but also by the two large quotation-units that structurally frame much of the entry’s moral grammar.

1. **Love The Good with all your heart, soul, and mind**
   - Locked core: `.i do bilga lo nu do prami lo si'o xamgu fi'o se srana ro le do cnise'i .e ro le do ruxse'i .e ro le do menli.`
   - Reading: total directedness toward The Good across heart, soul, and mind.

2. **This is the greatest and first commandment**
   - Locked core: `.i ti du lo pamoi je traji te minde.`
   - Reading: the first commandment is also the greatest one.

3. **A second is like it**
   - Locked core: `.i lo remoi te minde cu simsa le pamoi te minde.`
   - Reading: the second commandment belongs to the same kind or structure as the first.

4. **Love your neighbor as yourself**
   - Locked core: `.i do bilga lo nu do prami lo prenu poi jibni do tai lo nu do prami lo do sevzi.`
   - Reading: neighbor-love mirrors the ethical mode of self-love.

5. **All the law and prophetic utterance hang on these two commandments**
   - Locked core: `.i ro lo flalu .e ro lo se cusku be lo'i cespre cu se nibli le re te minde ...`
   - Reading: the whole normative and prophetic structure depends on those two commandments.

6. **Love is patient, love is kind**
   - Locked core: `.i lo si'o prami cu depcni. .i lo si'o prami cu xendo.`
   - Reading: the quotation opens with positive ethical-affective predicates before the later denials and constraints.

7. **Love does not rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth**
   - Locked core: `.i ri na gleki lo nu da na drani fi lo marde .i ku'i ri gleki lo fatci.`
   - Reading: love is morally aligned with truth and does not delight in moral wrongness.

8. **Love believes, hopes, and endures all things irwartfrr**
   - Locked core: `.i ri lacri ro da poi ke'a prenu lo nu da zukte lo drani. .i ri pacna lo nu lo xamgu cu se snada bu'u ro tcini. .i ri renvi ro tcini ...`
   - Reading: love remains trusting, hopeful, and enduring in the fitting way, at the fitting time, and for the fitting reasons.

This sixth index is meant to make the archive easier to use as a map of the two major scriptural quotation blocks, which continue to function as a backbone for the surrounding philosophical prose.

## Post-lock refinement note (v2337): Seventh compact index for the archive's working layers
